worldcombat.skill.boltbeak.summary: Darts in and stabs with an electrified beak before the target reacts: the power doubles when the target has not struck the user, and the user backsteps away after the peck.
worldcombat.skill.boltbeak.use.0: Peck before the foe can act
worldcombat.skill.boltbeak.use.2: Double up on a target that has not reacted
worldcombat.skill.boltbeak.description.0: Deals %1$s physical damage; the power doubles when the target has not struck the user in the last %2$s seconds and is not swinging at the user right now.
worldcombat.skill.boltbeak.description.1: Stabs up to %1$s blocks, %2$s blocks per tick, collision radius %3$s blocks; backsteps %4$s blocks after the peck.
worldcombat.skill.boltbeak.skirmish.on: Skirmish on: the backstep is 0.9 blocks longer for repeated first strikes, but each peck is about 10%% lighter and cooldown 4 ticks longer.
worldcombat.skill.boltbeak.skirmish.off: Skirmish off: hold ground for a heavier peck (about 11%% more) with a shorter backstep.
worldcombat.skill.boltbeak.timing: Castable on enemies within %1$s blocks; commits after %2$s s and costs %4$s PP; recovers for %3$s s and starts a %5$s s cooldown.
worldcombat.skill.boltbeak.growth.0: At level %1$s the peck power rises to %2$s.
worldcombat.skill.boltbeak.growth.1: At level %1$s the peck power rises to %2$s and the dart distance to %3$s blocks.
worldcombat.skill.boltbeak.preference.sk: On: the backstep is 0.9 blocks longer for repeated first strikes, but each peck is about 10%% lighter and cooldown 4 ticks longer. Off: hold ground for a heavier peck with a shorter backstep.
worldcombat.skill.boltbeak.preference.ai: Only darts at threats this close; a larger value charges in from further away to strike first.
On: darts as soon as the target has not struck the user (exactly the doubling window). Off: sorted like an ordinary melee attack.
